headline: Recommended revised library bylaws for further review; tabled a question on AI-generated materials in the collection.
summary: Bylaw edits include two term limit options, advisory groups only, and the new Public Outreach & Communications Committee name. The City's new Visitors' Code of Conduct now covers the whole building and replaces the library's Patron Code of Conduct. Staff will gather input on AI-generated items such as Libby titles and DVDs.
decisions: Approved the October 22, 2026 minutes, passed unanimously.
Recommended the revised library bylaws for the Board to consider at its next meeting, passed unanimously.
Tabled the question of AI-generated materials in the Collection Development Policy to another meeting.

plain_text:
Library Governance and Nominating Committee  
Draft Minutes  
November 18 , 2026 
 
 
The committee held a regular meeting on November 18, 2026 at 4:00 pm in the Board 
Room and by Zoom at 
https://us02web.zoom.us/j/83148399416?pwd=3FyGowW0tr9sobN7az059tEKduoY1v.1 
 
Members present: Marty Reid, Chair; Anne LaLonde, Donna Swartwout, Christy Liddy-
Repstad 
 
Members absent:  
 
Others present: Bree Drapa, Library Director 
 
1. Call to Order (4:01)  
 
The chair called the meeting to order.  
 
2. Review of Library Exits (4:01) 
 
The chair reviewed the library exits to use in case of an emergency. The doors are no 
longer locked during the meeting. 
 
3. Additions and deletions to the posted agenda (4:03)  
 
There were no changes to the agenda. The Chair noted that the wrong minutes were 
sent along with the official agenda. 
 
4. Comments and questions from the public not related to items on the agenda (4:03)  
 
None, no member of the public present in person or online 
 
5. Approval of the last meeting minutes from October 22, 2026 – ACTION (4:04)  
 
Donna moved to approve the minutes, Anne seconded the motion, and the motion 
passed unanimously. 
 
6. Library bylaws (4:07)  
 
The Committee included two options on term limits (pro and con) in Article II, Section 3 
for the Board to choose between. The full Board should discuss at each March meeting 
whether current Board members whose terms are up are thinking of returning. The
180 MARKET STREET , SOUTH BURLINGTON, VERMONT | (802) 846 -4107 | WWW.SOUTHBURLINGTONVT .GOV 
Board can do a straw poll of who is coming back and do a needs assessment of what 
the Board might need or want in additional members. We removed references to 
“working groups” in the bylaws, clarifying that the Board would have advisory groups 
only. We added the new name of the Communications Committee: the Public Outreach 
& Communications Committee! And we made a few other small edits for clarification. 
 
Anne moved to recommend this version of the library bylaws for the Board to consider 
at its next meeting, Donna seconded, and the motion passed unanimously. We 
applauded the bylaws and the work done to create this update. 
 
7. AI-generated materials and the Collection Development Policy (5:05) 
Bree will talk to the library leadership team and the staff to see what they think about 
having AI-generated materials in the collection, including Libby and DVDs as well as 
books. One possible change to the policy might be, “Content created by AI does not 
necessarily eliminate it from our collection.” The Committee will table this to another 
meeting. Bree also mentioned that there may be cataloging implications at a state level. 
 
8. Policy Review Schedule (5:18) 
The Chair went over the list of policies and when they were last updated, noting policies 
we should look at in 2027. We will look at the art guidelines and the records policy at 
our next meeting. 
 
The Committee should look at these three policies together: The Auditorium Rental & 
Usage Policy, the Library Use Fee Summary, and the Room Rental, Usage Policies & 
Procedures. The Library is hoping to launch its new room reservation software in 
January.  
 
The City’s new Visitors’ Code of Conduct applies to the entire building and supercedes 
our Patron Code of Conduct. We can still have specific conduct policies for the Library 
as long as they don’t contradict the City’s Code of Conduct. 
 
9. Other business (5:28)  
 
None 
 
10. Adjourn (5:30) 
 
Respectfully submitted,  
Anne LaLonde, Secretary, Governance and Nominating Committee
